scrapers.name: SoloLatino
scrapers.description: Spanish-dubbed/subtitled movies and series scraped from sololatino.net. embed69 links (its main working source) now resolve: implements AES-256-CBC decrypt and the SHA-256 proof-of-work it requires from scratch, since Nuvio's sandbox has no crypto module. Temporarily reports a single non-playable "⚠️ SoloLatino diag" entry instead of an empty list when it finds nothing, showing which stage (TMDB lookup, search, unpack, probe) came up empty -- remove once the on-device zero-results reports are diagnosed.
scrapers.author: Ported from the Latino Stremio addon
